corrections.text: The article quotes the paper's experimental setup as using "PMD 7.10.0 for static analysis on Java 17." The paper does not use this exact phrasing; it states that code smells were detected and re-counted "using PMD 7.10.0 on Java 17 with the refactai-pmd-ruleset.xml ruleset." The PMD version and Java version cited are both accurate, but the quoted wording was paraphrased rather than reproduced verbatim from the source.
